To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the dimeric ribosome is a vestige of the pre-RNA world, that it could have been involved in the emergence of life and that it could have enabled the evolution of translation.

the dimeric proto-RNA ribosome, which could be formed spontaneously in the primordial world, could have catalyzed peptide bond formation and peptide chain elongation, thus initiating a process of co evolution of the ribosome and the proteins.

the dimeric proto ribosome, a symmetric pocket-like entity composed of two L shaped RNA units, encloses the peptide synthesis site in the contemporary ribosome and could have formed spontaneously on early Earth, catalyzing peptide synthesis.
